evidence: The cited resource is a government press-release/data-source portal rather than a dataset package. Primary paper 714 states that cumulative infected, recovered and deceased Italy counts were downloaded from Italian Civil Protection; separate official DPC structured datasets exist but are not identity-conflated with CR000329.

The cited Ministry portal is an institutional information/data-source page rather than a versioned dataset package. Current official COVID-19 pages link reports, monitoring and open-data resources. Paper 714 states that study counts were downloaded from this Ministry source together with Civil Protection.

The resource is a Minnesota government COVID-19 news/intervention archive, not a dataset. It contains dated policy announcements and executive-order news relevant to Minnesota; it cannot serve as Italy intervention data solely because paper 714 cites it adjacent to an Italy timeline discussion.
